company.name: Hamberger Großmarkt
company.distributes: Cash and carry wholesale with about 46,000 food and 14,000 non-food items, including confectionery.
company.channels_supplied: Gastronomy and small retailers from its Berlin Moabit market, plus a delivery service.
what_they_do_well: Opened a Berlin wholesale market in Moabit with about 60,000 items.
company.fit_rationale: Owner-run wholesaler with a large Berlin market serving restaurants and small retailers, a route into Berlin's independent trade. Gastronomy focus makes it secondary for a retail snack range.

company.name: Löwenzahn Cash & Carry GmbH
company.distributes: General grocery wholesale including confectionery and snacks, drinks and ethnic food.
company.fit_rationale: Berlin cash and carry with a listed confectionery and snacks range. Limited public detail on customers and scale.

company.name: Monolith Gruppe
company.distributes: Eastern European specialty foods, more than 4,000 items including Russian sweets, drinks, meat and fish.
company.channels_supplied: About 2,500 trade customers including the Mix Markt store network and food retail; Berlin outlets not confirmed.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 1997, six German sites and more than 500 staff.
company.fit_rationale: Large importer-wholesaler with its own retail network for Eastern European communities. Range is ethnic, so a British sugar-free brand is an unusual fit.
